structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标由清晰的几何图形（爆炸气泡）和具象符号（小电视）组成，符合 theme_rules 中 'preserve_when' 的条件。参考 bilibili 主App的处理方式，应保留其核心拓扑结构（气泡在上，电视在下），仅对填充色、描边风格和细节复杂度进行主题化重构，而非重新设计主体。
preserve: 爆炸形/锯齿状边缘的对话气泡轮廓
气泡内的汉字“漫画”字形骨架
底部小电视（TV头）造型及双天线特征
小电视面部的极简线条表情（眯眼/波浪嘴）
前景手势与背景文字的层叠遮挡关系
must_preserve: 汉字“漫画”的可识别性（即使风格化为手绘体）
小电视的天线位置和屏幕脸部的基本布局
爆炸气泡的整体外轮廓拓扑结构
recompose_allowed: 将平滑矢量描边替换为粗细不均的黑色马克笔手绘描边
将原图青/粉/白等颜色映射为主题限定色板（砖红、深蓝、奶黄）
简化小电视面部细节，去除立体光影，转为平面色块
调整气泡与电视的比例以适应中心构图，去除多余装饰元素
restyle: 应用复古手绘涂鸦质感（蜡笔/粉笔颗粒感）
边缘处理为不规则、抖动的粗糙效果
内部填充改为无渐变的高饱和度平涂色块
字体风格转化为粗犷的手写涂鸦风
decorate: 可在色块内部添加简单的几何点缀（如四角星、圆点）以增强拙朴感
保持构图松散自由，允许元素间轻微重叠
forbid: 禁止保留原图的青色、粉色、绿色等非主题色系颜色
禁止使用平滑、锐利的工业级矢量描边
禁止添加任何阴影、高光、环境光遮蔽或3D立体效果
禁止移除或替换“漫画”文字为其他图形
禁止将小电视变形为无法识别的抽象几何体
禁止使用白色或其他非黑色背景
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle icon on pure black background. Central composition featuring a jagged comic speech bubble with stylized handwritten Chinese characters '漫画' inside. Below the bubble sits a simplified Bilibili TV-head mascot with two antennas. Use thick, shaky black marker outlines. Fill shapes with flat, high-saturation blocks of brick red, deep blue, and creamy yellow. No gradients, no shadows, naive art style, crayon texture.
color_application: Map original multi-color palette to theme's limited triad: Brick Red, Deep Blue, Creamy Yellow. Replace all gradients and complex shading with solid flat fills. Ensure high contrast against the pure black background.
stroke_application: Replace original clean vector lines with thick, irregular, hand-drawn black outlines. Edges should appear rough and shaky, simulating a marker or crayon stroke. No smooth Bezier curves.
composition_application: Center the combined 'Bubble + TV Head' structure. Maintain the vertical stacking (Bubble top, TV bottom) but simplify internal details. Subject should occupy 60-70% of the canvas, leaving uniform black breathing space around edges.
identity_application: Preserve the specific topology of the 'Comic' speech bubble and the Bilibili TV mascot (antennas + screen face). Stylize the '漫画' text into a bold, handwritten form that remains legible. Keep the mascot's iconic lazy/playful expression via minimal lines.
fidelity_constraints: Must apply thick, shaky hand-drawn black outlines
Colors strictly limited to Brick Red, Deep Blue, Creamy Yellow flat blocks
No gradients, shadows, lighting effects, or glossy textures
Subject must be flattened into geometric block combinations
negative_constraints: No realistic, photorealistic, or 3D rendered elements
No original brand colors (cyan, pink, etc.) unless they match the theme palette
No thin, clean, or perfect vector lines
No removal of the '漫画' text or distortion of the TV mascot beyond recognition
